title: Himeji Castle — official visitor information

facts.fact: The official castle handbook distinguishes regular adult admission, Himeji resident admission and a castle/Koko-en combination; its current table must be used rather than pre-2026 rates.
facts.excerpt: Combined ticket for Himeji Castle and Kokoen Garden

facts.fact: Visitors remove outdoor shoes inside the main keep and other buildings; the operator recommends bringing a shoe bag and thick socks or suitable indoor shoes.
facts.excerpt:
Please bring thick socks or comfortable indoor shoes.
The inside of the buildings (Main Keep etc.) is a wooden floor.
Because it is slippery and dangerous, also there is a risk of damaging cultural properties with heels of shoes, please do not use the provided shoe bags as shoe covers.
No outdoor shoes are allowed inside the buildings (Main keep. etc.).
facts.location: 2026.11.01 visitor notice, raw extracted TXT lines15–19. Line15 asks for a shoe bag; line19 explicitly disallows outdoor shoes. The quoted sentences establish permitted/recommended indoor footwear.

facts.fact: Historic tower and turret interiors have no elevator and steep narrow stairs; wheelchairs cannot enter those buildings.
facts.excerpt:
There are no elevators in the castle tower or turrets.
Although there are handrails, the stairs are very steep and narrow.
Please note that wheelchairs are not accessible inside buildings such as the main keep and turrets.
facts.location: 2026.11.01 visitor notice, raw extracted TXT lines27–29

facts.fact: The station-side arrival references are JR Himeji and Sanyo Himeji; the official handbook describes walking or a bus from the north exit to Otemon-mae.
